title: Example: record a demo with the R key
summary: A second example plan, for a different change, run on your own computer instead of a link. Pressing **R** while playing now records a demo: the level starts over, and pressing **R** again saves the recording as a file your browser downloads. Demos replay a game exactly, so a recording of a bug is the clearest way to report one.

setup.title: Check out the commit this plan was written for
setup.body: In a clone of `mandreljs/mandrel.js` (Node.js 24 or newer). This works for pull requests from forks too.
setup.code:
git fetch origin pull/123/head
git checkout 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

setup.title: Install and start the game
setup.body: `npm run setup` downloads the map compiler the first time and does nothing after that. `npm run dev` keeps running while you test.
setup.code:
npm install
npm run setup
npm run dev

setup.title: Open the game
setup.body: Open `http://localhost:5173/?map=test_movement` in Chrome or Edge. Click inside the game to capture the mouse.

tests.title: R starts a recording from the start of the level
tests.why: This is the main change in the pull request.
steps: Walk forward a few steps with **W**.
expected: You're back where the level starts, as if it had just loaded.

tests.title: R again saves the recording as a download
tests.before: You need the recording from the previous test.
steps: Walk around for a few seconds.
expected: Your browser downloads a file whose name ends in `.demo.json`.

setup.title: Open the game in Firefox
setup.body: Leave the terminal running, and open `http://localhost:5173/?map=test_movement` in Firefox.

tests.title: Recording works in Firefox too
steps: Click inside the game, then press **R**.
Walk around for a few seconds, then press **R** again.
expected: The level starts over when you first press R.
Firefox downloads a `.demo.json` file when you press R again.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: Dying still starts the level over
steps: Open `http://localhost:5173/?map=test_combat` and click inside the game.
Walk toward the enemy and let it shoot you until you die.
Wait a second, let go of every key, then click.
expected: The view drops to the floor when you die.
Clicking starts the level over with full health.

notCovered: Replaying a recorded demo. That's checked by the automated golden demo tests.
